name: Exp_RSI
summary: This EA trades based on RSI overbought/oversold signals, entering buy positions when RSI crosses below the oversold level and sell positions when RSI crosses above the overbought level. It is a classic mean reversion system that assumes price will revert to the mean after reaching extreme RSI readings. The EA automates signal detection and trade execution without manual intervention.
summary_zh: 该EA基于RSI超买超卖信号进行交易,当RSI下穿超卖水平时买入,当RSI上穿超买水平时卖出。这是一个经典的均值回归系统,假设价格在达到极端RSI读数后将回归均值。EA自动完成信号检测和交易执行,无需人工干预。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于RSI指标的均值回归原理,认为当价格达到超买或超卖区域后会发生反转。入场条件为RSI从超卖区域上穿超卖线时开多单,RSI从超买区域下穿超买线时开空单。出场条件通常包括固定的止盈止损,或当RSI回到中轴50附近时平仓。仓位管理一般采用固定手数或基于资金的百分比计算。资金管理方面,典型实现可能缺少动态仓位调整和最大回撤控制,风险主要依赖止损设置。该策略在震荡行情中表现较好,但在强趋势行情中可能连续止损。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the mean reversion principle of the RSI indicator, assuming price reversals occur after reaching overbought or oversold zones. Entry conditions trigger a buy when RSI crosses above the oversold level and a sell when RSI crosses below the overbought level. Exit conditions typically include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, or closing positions when RSI returns to the midline around 50. Position sizing generally uses fixed lots or a percentage of account equity. Money management in typical implementations may lack dynamic position adjustment and maximum drawdown controls, relying primarily on stop-loss settings for risk. The strategy performs well in ranging markets but may suffer consecutive losses during strong trending conditions.
pros: RSI是经典且广泛验证的技术指标,逻辑清晰易懂
均值回归策略在震荡市场中表现稳定,胜率较高
参数可调性强,交易者可根据不同品种和市场条件优化设置
pros_en: RSI is a classic and widely validated technical indicator with clear and understandable logic
Mean reversion strategy performs stably in ranging markets with a relatively high win rate
Highly adjustable parameters allow traders to optimize settings for different instruments and market conditions
cons: 在强趋势行情中容易连续亏损,逆势交易风险大
典型实现缺少新K线检查,可能同一信号重复开仓
缺少点差过滤和滑点保护,在流动性差的市场中可能造成额外损失
cons_en: Prone to consecutive losses in strong trending markets due to counter-trend trading risk
Typical implementation lacks new bar checking, potentially opening duplicate positions on the same signal
Lacks spread filter and slippage protection, which may cause additional losses in low-liquidity markets
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器(如均线方向),在趋势行情中暂停交易或切换为趋势跟踪模式
添加新K线检查机制防止重复开仓,并加入点差过滤和最大持仓限制
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., moving average direction) to pause trading or switch to trend-following mode during trending markets
Implement new bar checking to prevent duplicate entries, and add spread filtering with maximum position limits

risk_points: 逆势交易在强趋势中可能造成较大回撤
缺少新K线检查可能导致同一信号重复开仓放大风险
止损设置可能不够合理,固定点数止损未考虑市场波动性
risk_points_en: Counter-trend trading may cause significant drawdowns during strong trends
Lack of new bar checking may lead to duplicate position opening on the same signal, amplifying risk
Stop-loss settings may be inadequate as fixed-pip stops don't account for market volatility

It is a classic mean reversion system that assumes price will revert to the mean after reaching extreme RSI readings. The EA automates signal detection and trade execution without manual intervention.
